label: Conan Exiles sandboxes
description: How Conan Exiles sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Conan loads only the paks named in ConanSandbox/Mods/modlist.txt, one path per line. This app does not write it; add the mod's .pak there. BattlEye runs on official servers and rejects a modified client, so mods are for private or single-player use.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
